name: portravo
description: Turn an owned construction plan into a reviewable takeoff. Check active automated trades and the exact existing-credit cost before starting, attach the actual PDF to a project, and recover progress without rerunning the job. Review quantities, returned source links and unresolved scope before exporting a reviewed estimate. Direct file transfer accepts up to 10 MiB; use the owned project upload page for plans up to 50 MiB. Credit guards do not buy credits or authorize billed overage.
